name: Bare Boob Brawlerz Visual Novel: Vol 1
source:
Bare Boob Brawlerz is back with a Visual Novel that's a prequel to the original Bare Boob Brawlerz game because that's what everyone is doing now! Yeah? Prequels? Prequels still hot?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/906560/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Bare Boob Brawlerz带着视觉小说回来了，这是原版Bare Boob Brawlerz游戏的前传，因为这就是每个人现在都在做的事情！是的？前传？前传还火吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/906560/]Steam[/url]]
